caption: Stock URP Lit through the project's own pipeline asset: trilight ambient, no fog, SampleSceneProfile post.
No shader code: skybox ambient instead of trilight, brighter sun with ACES tonemapping, distance fog, re-rendered reflection probe.
CristianQiu volumetric fog, looking back along the pillars toward the sun: the air itself is lit, and the pillars cut shadowed shafts through it.
Low angle, screen-space reflections OFF: the marble only reflects the baked probe.
jiaozi158 SSR: the marble reflects the pillars, spheres and head that are on screen, sharp near and blurred far.
NiloCat planar reflection: a mirror of the whole floor plane, also shows objects SSR cannot (off-screen, under-side), no roughness blur.
Corner without screen-space GI: ambient comes from the sky only, the red wall bounces nothing onto the white floor.
jiaozi158 SSGI: dynamic red bleed on the white floor and head computed from the screen every frame.
sinnwrig fog volume: a local raymarched fog box hugging the floor, lit by the sun, unlike the global distance fog.
Sphere rows (roughness 0 to 1, dielectric front, gold back) with stock URP Lit: SSAO darkens diffuse and specular equally, the metal crease keeps its mirror reflection in the corner.

Same shot with the hand-written Showcase/Lit: identical direct lighting, but AO now occludes reflections (Lagarde specular occlusion) and bounces albedo colour (multi-bounce AO) in the crease and under the spheres.
Head close-up with the current DefaultSkin Shader Graph: plain Lit, the light-to-shadow terminator on the granite is a hard Lambert edge.
Same shot with hand-written pre-integrated subsurface scattering: a curvature LUT softens and warms the terminator, as light would travel inside translucent stone.
Pool with the project's Water Shader Graph (Oasis material).
Hand-written HLSL water: depth-based colour, two scrolling normal layers, Fresnel reflection, shoreline foam.
Counter-example (GPL, demo only): Soung2279 BreathHalo on the prop; a flat, pulsing rim glow that ignores the scene's light.
Everything realistic together: lighting pass + volumetric light + SSR + SSGI + fog volume + Showcase_Lit + SSS + HLSL water.
